card.name: Volume digits in journal citations
card.fires_on: A digit in the journal volume number of a reference, right after the year and before the colon and page range. Also the period after 'p' in a page citation.

modes.label: Volume digit
modes.description: A digit of the volume number after the year in a reference list entry.

modes.label: Page marker period
modes.description: The period after 'p' that introduces the page range in a citation.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward citation-style tokens such as 'pp' and 'doi', which come next in references.
card.plain: It fires on the volume number inside a journal reference, just before the page numbers.
